items.q: Do I have to change my ERP or systems?
items.a: No. We integrate with what you already use. If your system has no integration, we work with files or spreadsheets.

items.q: How long does a project take?
items.a: The first stage is usually up and running in 6 to 10 weeks. Bigger projects are split into stages so you see results fast.
It depends on scope, but we work with a fixed price per stage: you know what you'll pay before starting.

items.q: What happens if the AI gets something wrong?
items.a: That's why everything goes through human approval. The AI builds the draft and your team validates it. The system also learns from every correction.
Your data is yours. We use per-client databases, daily backups, and restricted access.

items.q: Will my team be able to use it?
items.a: Yes. We design for the people who use it every day, train them, and provide support. If something doesn't get used, we adjust it.

problem_solution.title: The Problem vs. The Solution
problem_solution.subtitle: Understanding the obstacle is the first step to overcoming it. This is how we transform friction into growth.

problem.title: What is holding back my company's growth today?
problem.p1: What limits growth is usually not the market, but the internal operation: manual processes, scattered information, and little real-time visibility. This mean that each new branch, customer, or operational unit requires more work, more staff, and more coordination.
problem.strong: In that scenario, scaling becomes slow, expensive, and unsustainable.
problem.p2: Datelia solves that bottleneck by automating repetitive tasks, integrating critical information into a single panel, and standardizing the way all areas of the company work.
problem.italic: The result: less operational load, more traceability, and an operation that grows without friction.

solution.title: What exactly does Datelia do to solve these problems?
solution.p1: We apply a proven approach that combines automation, AI, and Business Intelligence to organize, accelerate, and make the operation more efficient.
solution.p2: We automate shifts, reports, data entry, customer follow-up, and internal controls. We centralize information in a single dashboard and design standardized flows that eliminate errors and duplications.
solution.roi: Automation reduces manual tasks from the first few weeks of use and speeds up decision-making across the whole operation.

mvp.title: What happens after the MVP?
mvp.p1: After the MVP, two key stages follow to ensure continuous improvement:
mvp.list_1: Scaling by areas (administration, sales, logistics, after-sales, operations).
mvp.list_2: Real-time BI dashboards to ensure traceability and more precise decisions.
mvp.p2: In addition, we provide continuous support, evolutionary improvements, and internal training so that the solution grows along with the company.

caso_cedsa.title: CEDSA: automatic control of payment reports
caso_cedsa.summary: Automatic control of payment reports from field representatives. No more spreadsheets, hello alerts.
caso_cedsa.ficha: Educational institution · Salta, Argentina · 51-200 employees · 2025 project
caso_cedsa.starting_point: Field representatives reported cash payments using Excel spreadsheets. Treasury had to reconcile them one by one against the management system by hand. As the number of units grew, control became unmanageable and errors were caught late.
what_we_did: A secure web form for each representative to submit their reports.
Automatic rules that flag irregularities and alert by email.
Direct integration with CEDSA's management system.
caso_cedsa.result: The process went from spreadsheets and manual checks to a centralized, automatic flow.
caso_cedsa.quote: What impressed us was Datelia's understanding of a specific operational problem and creating a practical solution.

caso_la_tablada.title: La Tablada: 300 suppliers and quotes in minutes
caso_la_tablada.summary: Price lists from 300 suppliers processed automatically, and quotes built from a Telegram voice note.
caso_la_tablada.ficha: Commercial distribution, construction sector · Salta, Argentina · 11-50 employees · Ongoing project (2026)
caso_la_tablada.starting_point: La Tablada receives price lists from around 300 suppliers, each in its own format. Updating costs and building quotes was manual, slow, and depended on a handful of people. Price increases were caught late and discounts were granted with no centralized control.
what_we_did: Automatic email intake of price lists, reading PDF and Excel.
Product-code matching that learns from every correction the team makes.
Alerts for critical price increases and holds on quotes that need approval.
A Telegram bot so sales reps can request quotes with a voice note, a photo, or a message.
An approval panel and PDFs branded for La Tablada.
A dashboard for management: quotes, discounts by rep, and suppliers with the most increases.
caso_la_tablada.next_stage: WhatsApp, direct order entry into the Paljet ERP, and commercial intelligence dashboards.
caso_la_tablada.result: Processing price lists from 300 suppliers and building quotes stopped depending on a few people checking spreadsheets by hand.
caso_la_tablada.quote: What impressed us most was their ability to combine AI with the controls required by a real commercial operation.

hero.title: Expense reports without spreadsheets or chasing receipts
hero.subtitle: Your team uploads receipts from their phone. AI reads and validates them, and Treasury only reviews what doesn't add up.

sol_rendicion.problem: Expense reports arrive on paper, as photos, or in spreadsheets, each in a different format. Treasury spends days reconciling them against the system, and errors or irregularities are caught late, if at all. The more branches or representatives, the worse it gets.
steps: The employee photographs the receipt from their phone, even offline.
AI reads the receipt and fills in the data.
The system applies the control rules you define (amounts, duplicates, categories, deadlines).
Treasury approves from a panel and only looks at the exceptions.
Everything is logged and visible on a dashboard by person, branch, or route.
includes: Integration with your accounting system or ERP (e.g. Odoo)
sol_rendicion.cta_title: Does your team lose days reconciling expense reports?

hero.title: Orders and quotes that build themselves
hero.subtitle: Your customers and sales reps send orders however is convenient: a voice note, a photo, a message. The system turns it into a quote or an order loaded into your ERP.

sol_pedidos.problem: Orders come in through WhatsApp, email, phone calls, and spreadsheets. Someone transcribes them into the system by hand, with errors in products, quantities, or prices. Building a quote takes hours and depends on whoever knows the current prices.
steps: The order comes in through whatever channel you choose: web portal, WhatsApp, Telegram, or email.
AI identifies the customer, products, and quantities, even from a voice note or a photo.
A draft is built using current prices and margins.
A sales rep reviews and approves it. Discounts outside policy go to management for approval.
A branded PDF quote goes out, or the order is loaded directly into your ERP.
includes: Product identification that learns from every correction
ERP integration (Odoo, Paljet, and others available)
sol_pedidos.cta_title: Do orders come in through 3 different channels?

hero.title: Supplier price lists and invoices, processed automatically
hero.subtitle: You receive hundreds of price lists and invoices by email, as PDF or Excel. We read them, organize them, and flag anything that doesn't add up.

sol_facturas.problem: Every supplier sends their list in their own format and codes. Updating prices takes weeks, increases are caught late, and invoices are entered into the system by hand.
steps: A dedicated inbox receives the price lists and invoices.
AI extracts the data from PDF and Excel files.
The system matches the supplier's products to yours and learns from every correction.
If a price increases beyond what you defined, you get an alert.
A price history is kept per supplier, and invoices move to your ERP as drafts.
includes: Product-code matching that learns with use
sol_facturas.cta_title: Does updating supplier prices take you weeks?

hero.title: Your whole company in one dashboard
hero.subtitle: Sales, costs, suppliers, and sales performance, updated automatically. Decide with data, not gut feeling.

sol_tableros.problem: Information is scattered across the ERP, spreadsheets, and email. Getting a single number means asking someone for it, and by the time it arrives it's already outdated.
steps: We connect your sources: ERP, spreadsheets, in-house systems.
We unify and clean the data.
We build dashboards around the indicators you actually look at.
They update automatically. If needed, we add demand forecasting and purchase suggestions.
includes: Dashboards (Looker Studio, Power BI, or custom-built)
Optional: demand forecasting and purchase suggestions
sol_tableros.cta_title: Do you have to ask someone for a spreadsheet just to get one number?
